summary: Real 0.25 USDC Ausca Document OCR run completed on Base using a 21,530-byte scanned PDF. Provider, output digest, source digest, Base settlement and Runx notarization were independently verified; after the earlier pending-review cap cleared, Frantic #131 was claimed without repeating the provider payment.

observations.detail: Read SKILL and live document.ocr offer; pinned ocr-fixed-r8 and schema digests.
Committed 21,530-byte application/pdf; returned ref/digest/media type/size matched local bytes.
Unsigned POST /v1/extract-text returned x402 v2, 250000 atomic USDC, Base, expected asset/payTo.
Base tx settled exactly 250000 atomic USDC; receipt status 1.
Paid request returned HTTP 202 status=accepted, initial state admitted, settlement metadata present.
One owner-page poll reached succeeded; independent readback revalidated terminal state.
Schema valid, 31 OCR lines, source digest matched input; recomputed sorted compact JSON digest matched output_digest.
Immediate receipt fetch briefly returned 404; same URL became readable after Runx notarization.
Final live preparation through receipt notarization, including local wallet review/signing.

findings: Naming is split across document-ocr, document.ocr, text-extract schema filenames and /v1/extract-text.
The live 402 contains a Bazaar example idempotency key alongside the authoritative runx.invocation idempotency key.
SKILL prose implies per-line page values, but the schema makes page optional and this PDF result omitted page on all 31 lines.
receipt_ref.public_url can be returned before the public receipt route is readable; this run showed a brief 404 before notarization.

claim_state.recovery_note: The earlier claim POST was authoritatively rejected with HTTP 409 pending_review_limit. After #132/#133 review cleared, that exact rejected attempt was reconciled locally and one fresh claim succeeded. No provider payment or OCR invocation was repeated.

redaction_note: No wallet private key, seed, Frantic token, wallet password, payment signature, or provider capability is included.
